goal: Deliver the publication-ready SDA-v1 learner content (kept as draft pending human approval) for SDA-M03-L01 — Application layers and microservices

in_scope: Use approved SDA-v1 and the canonical outputs from Story SDA-M03-L01.

**Prerequisites:** M02-L03

**Outcomes:** M03-L01-LO1: trace/model the mechanisms below in the worked scenario. M03-L01-LO2: choose and defend an alternative using the stated decision and failure criteria.

**Teaching sequence:**
1. Separate web, application and data responsibilities.
2. Modular monolith versus microservices, domain ownership and independent scaling.
3. Service boundaries, network overhead, distributed transactions and deployment/operability costs.

**Worked-example plan:** Compare separating media processing with splitting every entity into a service.

**Trade-offs and when to use/avoid:** Decompose for justified ownership or scaling needs; avoid distributing tightly coupled invariants.

**Quick-check focus:** Identify a boundary that creates unnecessary synchronous fan-out. The separate companion measures LO1 with Q1–Q3 and LO2 with Q4–Q6 plus EX-1; it will include explanations and an outcome map.
Cover the approved topic IDs PR-H078, PR-H079, PR-H081.
out_of_scope: Other milestones, workflow changes, merge and publication.

constraints: Coordinate through GitHub Issue #61. Preserve archived records in PR #38 and adapt suitable draft material from ec753d7.
Write original English draft material for middle and senior engineers. Verify technical claims with exact primary sources.
Use the pinned Primer as a topic map. Keep exercises in companion artifacts and label scenario assumptions.

definition_of_done.text: Deliver checked claim-level evidence at the canonical path.

Deliver canonical Story teaching and assessment/integration content at publication quality, with no known substantive learning, correctness, scoring, or measurement gaps; keep the workflow status draft until human approval.

acceptance_criteria.text: Record exact source sections, version or publication scope and limits. Recheck changed and volatile claims.
Teach every numbered outline item at M03-L01 with problem, mechanism, worked example, trade-offs, applicability and quick checks.
Keep status draft pending human approval; companion measures lesson-specific outcomes and includes explanations, rubric and explicit map.
Cover all assigned topic IDs; preserve the approved boundaries with adjacent lessons.

Produce complete learner-facing teaching and assessment artifacts at author handoff, not prototypes. Explain assigned mechanisms causally with a concrete trace, API contract or diagram when needed. Grade design under realistic failure and user-success constraints, naming SLO population/window/threshold and counting shed, rejected, expired, failed or late work where applicable. No filler or diagram quota; human publication approval remains separate.
